TESTS: PASS. 33 gate + 14 scope; whole early-access suite 157 files / 2400 passed / 25 skipped; tsc clean. KNOWN RISKS: (1) the gate is only as good as its facts resolver - whoever writes canonicalFacts must NOT wire supplier/inventory/lot/COA/fulfillment readiness into commerceHold, because the founder rule 5 says those must not block ACCEPTING an order; the type has no field for them so it cannot happen by accident, only by someone adding one. (2) null from canonicalFacts fails CLOSED by design - if the resolver is flaky the shelf shrinks rather than opening; that is the intended direction but it means a broken resolver looks like a small catalog, so please alarm on admitted-count. INTEGRATION INSTRUCTIONS: the live flip is ONE line in each of server/research/early-access/cart/adapters.ts:73 and server/research/early-access/release/release-routes.ts:161, changing scope from released_units to canonical_eligible and passing canonicalFacts + paymentPolicy. I deliberately did NOT make that change: it is the moment the live storefront changes, so it should be yours, behind a flag, with flag-off as the first rollback. Pass DIRECT_PURCHASE_FAMILIES from customer-pathway.ts as paymentPolicy.directPurchaseFamilies once that file is committed - it still is not on any pushed commit. PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO.
